criterionRatings.name: typography
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Native board text is readable in the original capture, but the exported panels shrink it severely. At720x405 the board content and local-mode disclosure are largely unreadable without the separate full-size PNG; large narrative captions are still readable.
criterionRatings.scope: Typography of the actual native capture and fixed MP4/GIF outputs only.

criterionRatings.name: spacing/grid
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: Two small board panels occupy a narrow middle band with large unused space above and below. Viewing the underlying PNG is a workaround for reading the result; the available output area is not used effectively.
criterionRatings.scope: Spacing and framing of the observed fixed composition; no responsive layout inference.

criterionRatings.name: color/token discipline
criterionRatings.deductionOrMissingEvidence: The dark navy/green palette and client accents remain coherent. Muted supporting text and mixed emoji/chrome treatments leave minor visual polish friction; no token audit or measured contrast certification was performed.
criterionRatings.scope: Perceptual color discipline in the captured example and exported theme only.

criterionRatings.name: hierarchy

criterionRatings.name: rendered legibility/contrast

criterionRatings.scope: Native-size output legibility, with native capture as the before-scaling reference.
